WA Rules for Pools and Spas (2025): 1200 min. on the
Shaded: the 900 non-climbable zone (NCZ 1) outside barriers
under 1800. Nothing climbable is to be built in it (no
taps, ledges or footholds), and anything movable put
there (pots, furniture, a BBQ) must be kept out of it.
Keep pots and planters 900 mm clear of the boundary fence
(B5), or they count as a climbable foothold.
B2: the kitchen slider opens from the house into the pool
area. A fixed security screen is to be fitted (estimate 7
Oct); SK02 also notes re-glazing it to pool requirements.
B4: the retaining wall is the barrier on the canal side. Its
face must stay smooth (no footholds). The pump room doors
(1700 x 950) sit in it under the deck, opening out onto
the promenade; the pump room has no opening into the pool
The pavilion's pillar is inside the fence, 28 from it.
